name: 男の子（基本・軽い持ち物）
author: kaede

source.prompt: Derived one-hand light-carry sheet (2026-08-13 差し戻し④): the walk cells are ../avatar-carry/sheet-original.png with the OUTER (far) hand erased per cell by scripts/factory/derive_light_carry.py — deterministic pixel op, no generation. The v4 two-hand belly carry keeps the NEAR hand crossing in front of the torso; erasing the far hand (which sticks out past the torso silhouette) leaves the owner-approved v1 reading of a one-hand carry with the far arm hanging invisibly behind the torso. Cast attempts at a still one-hand walk were rejected three times (seedance re-poses the held arm; nano re-poses inconsistently per cell), so the light family derives from the heavy family until a stable one-hand master exists. Item anchors = the near hand, measured per frame on this sheet.
